# Function: add()

> **add**(`point`, `vector`): [`Point`](../type-aliases/Point.md)

Defined in: math/vector/add.ts:16

Point moved by a vector, component-wise.

Formula: p + v = (pₓ + vₓ, p_y + v_y) — vector addition, the point being read as its vector
from the origin.

## Parameters

### point

[`Point`](../type-aliases/Point.md)

start point

### vector

[`Vector`](../type-aliases/Vector.md)

displacement

## Returns

[`Point`](../type-aliases/Point.md)

the moved point

## Kind

math
